answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because zephyr only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
